DEWARIM_STUDIO.Title: Studio
DEWARIM_STUDIO.NoProjects: No content module installed. Create one with scripts/new-content-module.mjs in the repository, then restart Foundry.
DEWARIM_STUDIO.Inactive: {module} is not active in this world. Activate it under Manage Modules - the build writes into its compendium.
DEWARIM_STUDIO.Empty: Nothing in this project yet. Right-click documents or folders in the sidebar ("Add to project"), or drag them into the project's folder.

Build.NoPack: {module} has no Adventure compendium in this world - is the module active?

Report.Added: Pulled into the project because other content refers to them:
Report.Modules: Refers to other modules - add them to "requires" in the content module's module.json, or remove the references:
Report.SystemPacks: Uses game system compendiums (fine, the system is required anyway):
Report.Missing: References to documents that do not exist:
Report.FailedAssets: Files that could not be copied (the reference is kept as it was):

Table.Empty: Nothing here. Drop documents from a compendium or the sidebar onto the table, or create one.
Table.DeleteConfirm: Delete {count} document(s)? Undo in the footer brings them back while this window is open.
Table.BulkApplied: Set on {count} row(s) - Save to write.
Table.CopyHint: Copy the selected rows (or all shown) for a spreadsheet
Table.PasteHint: Paste rows from a spreadsheet, with a header row. Rows are matched by the _id column, otherwise by name; changes become pending edits.
Table.Pasted: Pasted: {edited} cell(s) changed (pending - Save writes them), {created} new.
Table.PasteNoKey: The pasted header needs an _id or a name column to find the rows.
Table.PasteCreate: {count} row(s) match no existing document. Create them (type: {type})?
Table.SourcesHint: Sources: the project, the world and every compendium - drag a row into the table or press +
Table.AddFromSource: Add to the table (a compendium entry is copied into the world)

Encounter.Title: Encounter editor
Encounter.HpHint: Empty: as the actor has it. A number: that many for every token. "roll": roll the actor's HP formula per token.
Encounter.DropActors: Drop actors here (from the sidebar or a compendium). Dropping the same actor again adds one.
Encounter.DropItems: Drop items here, then choose who carries them.
Encounter.ClickHint: Click on the canvas where the group should stand - Escape cancels.
Encounter.KindHint: group: tokens of the type ("Wolf 1"), HP and loot on each token. named: every token gets its own actor with a name - it keeps HP and loot when it shows up in another scene.
Encounter.NamesHint: Names separated by commas (Grimtooth, Snaga); the rest is numbered.
Encounter.UniqueHint: A linked actor: placed as itself, so its HP and items are the ones it has right now.
Encounter.AddFromSource: Add: an actor as a mob row, an item as loot

Draft.Label: Draft
Draft.SaveHint: Keep these rows on the scene - they go into the content module and can be placed again later, also in the play world
Draft.DeleteConfirm: Delete the draft "{name}" from {scene}? The rows stay in the editor.
Draft.Missing: Not found (deleted, or its compendium is not installed): {names}
Draft.MissingRow: Not found: deleted, or its compendium is not installed here

Encounter.CreatedReused: {count} token(s) placed on {scene}, loot added to the chest {chest}.

Rating.Title: Difficulty
Rating.XpHint: The row's XP: count times each creature's (by its CR). Friendly rows do not count.
Rating.Strong: CR above the party's level ({level}): hits hard.
Rating.AllyHint: Friendly: does not count against the party

Party.Label: against
Party.Name: Name
Party.MakePrimary: Make it the primary party (dnd5e: XP and loot go there, sheets rate against it)
Party.NotCounted: Not a character: in the party, but the budget counts characters only
Party.Empty: No characters in this party yet - drop some here.
Party.NoPlayers: No player owns a character yet.
Party.DropHint: Drop characters here to add them to the party.
Party.PickFirst: Choose a party (or make a new one) to drop characters into.
Party.Gone: That party does not exist any more.

Scene.Title: Scene contents
Scene.Name: Name
Scene.Linked: Linked: changes go to the actor itself
Scene.Label: Label
Scene.GlobalHint: Shown regardless of token vision; who may open it still follows the journal's permissions.
Scene.Empty: Nothing of this kind on the scene.

Commander.Title: Commander
Commander.EmptyColumn: Nothing here - drop documents from the sidebar or a compendium.
Commander.NoRule: Dropping a {source} on a {target} does nothing (yet).

Rule.RollChest: roll it, items into the chest

Commander.AlreadyThere: {actor} is on {scene} already - a linked actor is placed once per scene.
Commander.VariantHint: A copy of {name} in the project - give it its own name; its sheet opens.
Commander.PackHint: Read-only source: drag entries to other columns, or copy & edit them.
Commander.RegionPlaced: Region "{macro}" placed in the middle of {scene} - runs the macro when a token enters (Regions layer).
Commander.UndoNone: Nothing to undo - drops in this window can be taken back (the last 10)

Sources.FilterHint: Name words and conditions, e.g. goblin cr<=1/2. Operators: < <= > >= = !=. Keys: {keys}

Undo.ParentGone: the document it belonged to is gone
